Replace.Text: Moves selected unit to center of the camera view
Wake up all units of the same type.[n]Military units also wake up other military units of the same domain (land, naval, air).
Optionally wake up sleeping Missionary units when a rival Missionary enters the same settlement. Enabling this alert will also wake up any units with a rival already present.

Optionally wake up sleeping Missionary units in settlements that are not following your religion, or that are converted to another religion. Enabling this alert will also wake up any units already in such a settlement.
